bottlenecks.overlap: defines the period under saturated DB

primary.name: detector whole-graph (TRT gemm/conv + TRT head + selective_scan)
primary.evidence: d1_nsys_04.json detect_span_mean_ms; gemm_conv 1.822 + scan 0.377 + trt 0.426 fully hidden in detect graph
primary.uncertainty: nsys kernel ns are hardware timestamps; production period is 2.875 ms so ~0.23 ms sits outside detect
primary.removal_upper_bound_ms: not removable as a module; scan 0.38 ms is the largest attackable slice inside detect
primary.removal_upper_bound_fps: scan-only: 1000/(2.875-0.38) ≈ 400 if scan vanished and nothing else moved (upper bound, not a prediction)

secondary.name: detect-to-detect tail (exposed memcpy/staging + leftover tracker + host sync opportunity)
secondary.class_label: B. synchronization / scheduling plus C. memory staging / traffic
secondary.workload_scaling: 1080p staging ~47 MB DtoD (exposed memcpy 0.11 ms); 640x480 staging below 8 MB threshold (exposed memcpy 0.016 ms). Host cudaStreamSynchronize API 23 µs; opportunity loss is the rest of the tail.
secondary.evidence: p0_warm period 2.875 ms - detect span 2.65 ms; nsys memcpy k8 48 MB/frame; cudaStreamSynchronize 0.023 ms API in tail
secondary.uncertainty: cannot split the 0.23 ms into memcpy vs host vs tracker leftover with production clocks; nsys period is inflated to 3.62 ms

tertiary.name: fixed-capacity tracker association (occlusion + sinkhorn + 5x auction)
tertiary.workload_scaling: auction 34–35 µs/frame and sinkhorn 75–77 µs/frame identical on 05 (11 tracks) vs 04 (44 tracks). Occlusion 148–165 µs almost flat. NMS select 39 vs 243 µs DOES scale.
tertiary.overlap: partially exposed (occlusion 0.063, sinkhorn 0.063, auction 0.021 on MOT17-04)
tertiary.uncertainty: exposed fraction depends on detect overlap geometry; CUPTI may shift it
tertiary.removal_upper_bound_fps: 1000/(2.875-0.15) ≈ 367 if all exposed tracker association vanished

closure.next_optimization_class: D. detector compute (selective_scan 0.38 ms) is the largest single exposed-equivalent lever; secondary is 1080p DtoD staging if it is shown to cause the 0.11 ms exposed memcpy. Do not start with GMC FFT or S2 removal.
